text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki gave it her all in the race. 
However, the crowd's cheers were 
relentlessly directed toward Oguri Cap...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki asked her Trainer: Why 
couldn't she surpass Oguri Cap, even when 
delivering her absolute best performance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After analyzing the situation, they 
concluded that Oguri Cap was turning the 
crowd's cheers into her own power. If so, 
she would only continue to grow stronger 
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki stated that she needed a 
weapon of her own. Her Trainer conceived a 
way to weaponize her fighting spirit, but 
hesitated due to the high risks involved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Keeping that method to themselves, the 
Trainer suggests they look for other ways. 
And so, the next goal was set for the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
